770-1 Advance Notice of Adverse Action

See Most Recent Obsolete Policy

All Programs

Customers must be given advance notice of adverse action in most cases. An adverse action decreases, terminates, or suspends services and/or assistance to the household. The date that advance notice begins is the day the notice is mailed.

For exceptions to advance notice for all programs, refer to policy 770-2 .

Additional Considerations for Financial and Child Care

Advance notice is defined as 1 day.

Additional Considerations for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)

Advance notice is defined as 10 days.

Refer to policy 770-3 to determine when no notice is required for the SNAP program.

Additional Considerations for Refugee Cash Assistance (RCA)

Advance notice is defined as 10 days
